upstreams.name: claude-mem
upstreams.selectionPolicy: Expose claude-mem to Claude users as a pinned Firehorse marketplace dependency that installs the upstream plugin from its plugin/ subdirectory. Firehorse-pi also bundles the claude-mem npm package so Pi-only users have the worker scripts available without installing Claude Code. Do not merge the memory hooks, MCP server, worker scripts, or skills into the Firehorse Claude plugin; keep the original upstream runtime as the owner.

upstreams.name: impeccable
upstreams.selectionPolicy: Expose the skill directories exported by the upstream Claude plugin manifest, using upstream's generated Claude and Pi variants for adapter mirrors and the canonical skill/ source for core provenance when available.

upstreams.name: mattpocock-skills
upstreams.selectionPolicy: Expose the skills listed by the upstream Claude plugin manifest; do not expose deprecated, in-progress, personal, or misc skills unless upstream promotes them into that manifest or Firehorse explicitly allow-lists them later.

upstreams.name: pi-agent-memory
upstreams.selectionPolicy: Bundle the upstream Pi package and expose only its pi-mem extension plus mem-search skill through explicit node_modules/pi-agent-memory manifest paths. The package connects Pi sessions to the claude-mem worker; Firehorse-pi bundles claude-mem and starts/checks that worker for Pi-only harness use without forking the upstream runtime.

upstreams.name: pi-subagents
upstreams.selectionPolicy: Expose the upstream built-in pi-subagents agent set as Firehorse shared subagent definitions. Pi consumes these through the bundled pi-subagents package built-ins; Claude receives Claude-compatible mirrors generated from the same pinned source files.

upstreams.name: shadcn-ui
upstreams.selectionPolicy: Expose the official shadcn/ui agent skill because it provides required project-aware guidance for adding components, using registries, and applying presets reliably.
